history.content: ok so i dont really know how this works. but i guess im here. been feeling kind of low about myself the last few days
That sounds like a few days of feeling low about yourself, and just being here anyway. We can stay with it gently, or leave it where it is for now.
its not really sad exactly. more like. embarrassed at myself. me and my girlfriend got into it again and i was the one who lost it
I had that wrong, let me step back. Maybe this is closer to embarrassment, or something sharper around getting into it again, what word would fit best?

embarrassed is right. she made a comment about me still not having sorted out the job thing and i snapped. raised my voice, said stuff i didnt mean. she just went quiet and went to bed. i hate that i do that
That wince at yourself makes sense, especially after she went quiet and went to bed. We can stay with just that, if you want.

yeah. i think the thing is she wasnt even wrong. i havent sorted it out. so when she pokes at it i get defensive cause it already makes me feel like a failure. and then i prove her point by blowing up

That sounds like the comment hit the part that already felt like failure, and then the blow-up seemed to confirm it. Is the harsher part here more about being seen as not sorted, or about what you did after?

honestly the second one. what i did after. the job stuff i can live with, ill figure it out eventually. but the way i talked to her, thats not who i want to be with her. she deserves better than getting yelled at over my own crap

That lands as the hurting part, what you did after, not the job itself. It sounds like the moment turned into "I am not being who I want to be with her," which is a pretty sharp kind of self-judgment.
yeah thats it exactly. ok i didnt expect that to actually help a little. i should probably just go apologize to her properly instead of sitting here. thanks though
I'm glad it clarified something. That feels settled enough to leave here, and you can go to her with it now.
